scenario: AITA For ‘excluding’ my friend? | Hi. Fifteen year old talking, this is stupid lunch time school problems. We share food often between us because normally only one of us has lunch or we’re agreeing to split or whatever. Then , one of my others friends sat down, asked to try one. I agreed and gave them one. Then, friend three, calling her M, walked over, dumping her bag on the table. She then , literally lunging over the table at my food. M proceeded to plead with me and apologise and ask ‘nicely’. But I told them they’re only saying that becuase I told her to, and didn’t let her have one. Me finishing them off. Apparently I’m the asshole for excluding her, but I was just upset that she lunged straight for my food before even acknowledging me. Everyone else I shared with asked. I guess me refusing her as she attempted to ask again is borderline assholery. Reddit , AITA?
